description: Keep the whole dark tip inside every moving ring with the shown hand. Fill all fading traces together. Tips glide toward your retained aim; dotted threads preview the next 1.2 seconds. Full: drag each brass handle with LEFT for OPEN or RIGHT for PINCH, then release to retain its aim. Simplified: click to aim, use the OPEN/PINCH buttons. Begin when ready. Closing early or running out of time ends the episode.
